# Visualization gallery

The figures here are **synthetic teaching demonstrations**. They do not use private fish recordings, claim real detector accuracy or represent measured animal welfare. The first figure is drawn directly by the package; subsequent figures illustrate publication-style visual grammar with transparent base R code.

## Interactive synthetic trajectory explorer

Open the [browser-based synthetic 3D/XY/XZ/YZ explorer](../synthetic-explorer.html). It lets you scrub through five fully invented paths, toggle individual fish and view three orthogonal projections plus a conceptual isometric projection. It is **not** a real GoPro or empirically calibrated 3D result.

## 1. Native fish trajectory plot

```{r native-paths, fig.width=9, fig.height=5.2, fig.align='center'}
library(aquaTrajectories)
set.seed(202611)
toy <- aqt_simulate_tracks(n_fish = 5, n_frames = 200)
aqt_plot_paths(toy)
```

Function: [`aqt_plot_paths()`](../reference/aqt_plot_paths.html). No real animal position or tank calibration is implied.

## 2. Clearly synthetic cumulative paths

```{r synthetic-path-colors, fig.width=8, fig.height=5.3, fig.align='center'}
set.seed(202612)
n <- 120
x <- cumsum(rnorm(n, sd = 0.16))
y <- cumsum(rnorm(n, sd = 0.11))
plot(x, y, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "#4B7189",
     xlab = "Simulated X (arbitrary units)",
     ylab = "Simulated Y (arbitrary units)",
     main = "Synthetic observed path — example only", asp = 1)
lines(tail(x, 30), tail(y, 30), col = "#13A0AE", lwd = 4)
points(tail(x, 1), tail(y, 1), pch = 21, bg = "#15BDC4", cex = 1.7)
legend("topleft", legend = c("Historical steps", "Last 30 steps"),
       col = c("#4B7189", "#13A0AE"), lwd = c(2, 4), bty = "n")
```

For calibrated 3D tank positions, see [`aqt_plot_trajectory_storyboard3d()`](../reference/aqt_plot_trajectory_storyboard3d.html) instead of treating image pixel coordinates as measured depth.

## 3. Synthetic spatial occupancy concept

```{r synthetic-occupancy, fig.width=7.4, fig.height=5.4, fig.align='center'}
set.seed(202613)
xy <- cbind(rnorm(600, 0.45, 0.18), rnorm(600, 0.56, 0.16))
xy <- pmin(1, pmax(0, xy))
bins <- 15
tab <- matrix(0, bins, bins)
ii <- pmax(1, pmin(bins, floor(xy[, 1] * bins) + 1))
jj <- pmax(1, pmin(bins, floor(xy[, 2] * bins) + 1))
for (k in seq_along(ii)) tab[ii[k], jj[k]] <- tab[ii[k], jj[k]] + 1
image(seq(0, 1, length.out=bins), seq(0, 1, length.out=bins),
      tab, col = hcl.colors(24, "YlGnBu"), xlab="Normalized X",
      ylab="Normalized Y", main="Synthetic binned point occupancy")
```

This is illustrative observed *point density*, not a biologically validated territory or a physically calibrated tank voxel analysis. See [`aqt_voxel_occupancy()`](../reference/aqt_voxel_occupancy.html) for 3D observed XYZ occupancy.

## 4. Synthetic intervention-aligned speed illustration

```{r synthetic-speed, fig.width=8.8, fig.height=5, fig.align='center'}
set.seed(202614)
t <- seq(-15, 30, length.out = 120)
a <- 3.5 + 0.3*sin(t/5) + rnorm(length(t), sd=.13)
b <- 3.4 + 0.18*sin(t/7) + 0.6*exp(-pmax(t,0)/9)*(t >= 0) +
     rnorm(length(t), sd=.13)
plot(t, a, type="l", lwd=2.5, col="#2B7289", ylim=range(a,b),
     xlab="Seconds relative to hypothetical event onset",
     ylab="Synthetic speed (arbitrary units)",
     main="Event-locked curves — synthetic only")
lines(t,b,col="#1AB6AD",lwd=2.5)
abline(v=0,lty=2,col="#A67D2D")
legend("topright", c("Illustrative condition A","Illustrative condition B"),
       col=c("#2B7289","#1AB6AD"),lwd=2.5,bty="n")
```

Do not infer significance, randomization or a welfare difference from this diagram. For externally observed, tank-replicated measurements, consult [`aqt_plot_speed_response()`](../reference/aqt_plot_speed_response.html) and [`aqt_plot_tank_changes()`](../reference/aqt_plot_tank_changes.html).

## 5. Native publication visualizations

The following documented figure families have their **own required input tables** and are not invoked here with fabricated biological values:

- [`aqt_plot_feeding_states()`](../reference/aqt_plot_feeding_states.html): externally defined feeding index and phase labels.
- [`aqt_plot_calibration_comparison()`](../reference/aqt_plot_calibration_comparison.html): independent physical target XYZ truth versus estimates.
- [`aqt_plot_occupancy_timeseries()`](../reference/aqt_plot_occupancy_timeseries.html): researcher-supplied occupied-area fractions for independent tanks.
- [`aqt_plot_speed_response()`](../reference/aqt_plot_speed_response.html): declared speed units, event onsets and tank observations.
- [`aqt_plot_heading_rose()`](../reference/aqt_plot_heading_rose.html): observed XY headings with optional supplied video raster frames.

A full synthetic five-figure workbook is already present in the repository at [inst/examples/publication_visualization_gallery.Rmd](https://github.com/stefanosbalaskas/AquaTrajectories/blob/v0.1.0/inst/examples/publication_visualization_gallery.Rmd). Run all five directly in the [website's five-figure workbook](five-figure-workbook.html). See the [publication figure guide](publication-figures.html).
